outcome: Post-operative pain (VAS score at 6th and 48th hour)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 74 women aged 40-70 years admitted to the hospital with stress-type urinary incontinence (SUI) who underwent surgical treatment between 2017 and 2024.
finding: Laparoscopic Burch colposuspension was superior to laparotomic Burch colposuspension in terms of significantly lower surgical time, blood loss, hospital stay, pain management, and recovery time, with both methods improving urinary incontinence symptoms and quality of life at 6-month follow-up.
